import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

def check(desc, got, expected):
    assert got == expected, f"{desc}\ngot={got!r}\nexpected={expected!r}"

# Multiple-user GET is sorted by name, regardless of payload order / storage order.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Chuck", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
check("get multiple", json.loads(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Bob", "Adam"]}))),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
      ]})
check("get all sorted", json.loads(api.get("/users")),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
          {"name": "Chuck", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
      ]})

# Borrower already owes lender: new IOUs add in the same direction.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
check("borrower owes lender, less", json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 2.0}))),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 5.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -5.0},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 5.0}, "balance": 5.0},
      ]})

# Repeated IOUs in opposite directions net correctly, including exact cancellation.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 5.25}))
check("add then reverse smaller", json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 2.25}))),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Adam": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0},
      ]})
check("reverse exact cancellation", json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 3.0}))),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
      ]})
check("state persists after cancellation", json.loads(api.get("/users")),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
      ]})

# Multiple counterparties are preserved and only affected users are returned.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Chuck", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Chuck", "amount": 4.0}))
check("third party untouched", json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 1.5}))),
      {"users": [
          {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 1.5, "Chuck": 4.0}, "balance": 5.5},
          {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Adam": 1.5}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -1.5},
      ]})

# Float precision: current implementation may produce artifacts here.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 0.1}))
res = json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 0.2})))
print("float-check result:", res)
print("ALL EDGE CHECKS PASSED (except informational float check)")
